renderer.renderer: ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (0x00007550) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

memoryInventory.scope: Descriptive resource inventory after the original timed case; quality cycling happens only in the Stable trial context.

snapshots.label: after matched measurement and dye check

imported.encodedBytesQualification: Delivery length only; not added to retained decoded buffers. Browser/network/raw-buffer retention is unknown.

snapshots.limits: Scene traversal includes hidden objects/material references. Totals deduplicate ArrayBuffers across categories; logical view bytes are separate. Excludes JS objects/recipes/control arrays, driver copies, render targets/shadows/postprocessing not referenced by scene materials, browser caches and unobserved module resources. Not total RAM or VRAM.

encounteredTextureCache.qualification: Union of bound textures encountered across changes. Dispose events are observed. Known rider atlas/material caches retain encountered atlases; unobserved/lazy normal maps are not allocated or assumed present by this inventory. Other undisposed encounters do not establish JS reachability or exact physical GPU residency. RGBA8 equivalents describe size, not measured driver allocation.
